base_protocol.used: its folds; its fold fits of the hurdle channels and the time prior on training households only, which are the fitted-rates protocol's; its recursion with the time prior; its metrics, minimal differences and household bootstrap

criteria.activity sub-states: success when home_active recall favours the model and none of balanced accuracy, log loss, calibration error and the recall of away, home_inactive, sleeping favours the reference; trade-off when home_active recall favours the model and at least one of them favours the reference; failure when home_active recall is negligible or favours the reference; inconclusive otherwise
criteria.multiplicity: one primary; the mechanism and per-state recall are read by their own rules and change no conclusion of W1
criteria.primary: W1 alone decides whether the sub-states replace the hurdle channels as the reference formulation on the development panel: only a success does; a trade-off does not; a success needs an independent dataset not yet scored with this family to be confirmed
criteria.verdicts: favours model: mean >= delta and lower bound > 0; favours reference: mean <= -delta and upper bound < 0; negligible: the whole interval within (-delta, delta); uncertain: anything else

estimands.question: what two activity sub-states in the common states add to the reference formulation, the fitted hurdle channels with the time prior, in the recursion

family.chosen: activity sub-states: each split state has two hidden sub-states, quiet and busy, each with its own hurdle parameters on every channel, and a Markov chain between them within the state
family.exactness: with each split state's two sub-states sharing the hurdle's parameters the model is exactly the reference, whatever its chain; tested to 1e-10 on simulated homes
family.not_split: the short, busy states bathroom_activity and kitchen_activity, whose bursts are fewer than independence predicts, and bed_awake, with too few homes
not_tested: exits that depend on the sub-state, which would replace the time prior's transition rather than add to it
family.output: the belief in a behavioural state is the sum over its sub-states
family.split_states: the states whose quiet runs or bursts the predictive checks found positive against each cell's own hurdle
why_one_family: The time prior's hour-dependent transition stays on the behavioural layer, so a sub-state's exit from its state is the prior's whichever sub-state it leaves. A Markov-modulated emission whose modulating chain is shared by the channels is then the same model as activity sub-states, and the two named families differ only in whether the modulation is shared or per channel.

Shared, not per channel: the predictive checks found the quiet-run excess on every channel with enough households, and the same mixture of a low and a high intensity in every household's active counts, which one level of activity shared by the channels produces; they did not examine dependence between channels, so nothing in them asks for a chain per channel. A chain per channel would be a factorial model, 64 sub-states per state with six channels.

fitting.collapse: nothing stops a sub-state from holding few windows; it then keeps its own pseudo-windows' pull toward the declared model and still enters inference; each sub-state's share of the training windows is reported
fitting.convergence: the change in the training log-likelihood over the last iteration is reported, not used; with the pseudo-windows the M-step does not maximise that likelihood, so it need not rise at every iteration
fitting.e_step: forward-backward within each stretch, each stretch entered from the entry distribution
fitting.entry: estimated at the first window of every stretch, which is an entry from another state or a restart after an unlabelled gap
fitting.iterations: all of them, with no stopping rule; the training log-likelihood at each E-step is recorded
fitting.m_step: each sub-state's hurdle is the base protocol's hurdle fit with every window weighted by its sub-state probability, with the same 12 pseudo-windows toward the declared model; the chain and the entry are the expected transition and entry counts, each with the pseudo-count
fitting.names: after fitting, the sub-state whose silence probability, averaged over the channels, is higher is called quiet; the names change no belief
fitting.no_window: a split state with no training window keeps two sub-states with the hurdle's parameters
fitting.settings: the odds factor, the persistence, a sub-state lasting 50 minutes on average, and the iterations were set before any CASAS household was fitted, and were not selected on data
fitting.start: both sub-states start from the fold's fitted hurdle rates; the quiet one with each channel's odds of silence multiplied by the odds factor, the busy one divided by it; the chain with the persistence on its diagonal; the entry even
fitting.unit: one fit per fold and split state, on the labelled windows of the fold's training households, in stretches of consecutive labelled windows of the state

inspected_before: The combined-prior record: in the recursion, the fitted hurdle channels with the time prior score a mean household balanced accuracy of 0.517 against 0.456 without the prior, K1 +0.061 [+0.044, +0.077], a success; K1's home_active recall difference is +0.002 [−0.002, +0.007], negligible, with home_active recall 0.268 with the prior and 0.266 without it.
The fitted-rates record: in the recursion the fitted hurdle channels lose 0.231 [0.172, 0.290] of home_active recall to the declared channels (FR).

The predictive-check record: against each cell's own hurdle, windows in quiet runs of at least an hour are 1.336 times the predicted in away, 5.187 in home_active, in the 15 households with enough runs, and 2.568 in home_inactive, each positive, and 1.116 in sleeping, negligible; bursts are positive in home_inactive, 1.596, and sleeping, 2.896, and negative in bathroom_activity and kitchen_activity; against the fold's population hurdle, quiet runs are 6.173 times the predicted in home_active, in 15 households, and 2.584 in home_inactive, positive, and negligible in away and sleeping; the own-reference quiet-run excess is positive on every channel with enough households, from 1.410 on bathroom motion to 2.561 on living-room motion; the active count's variance is 4.342 to 7.418 times the model's in the common states, above one in every household with a value; and its page describes the active counts as having too many single activations, too few mid-range counts and far too many large ones.

The negative-binomial record: against the hurdle, the zero-truncated negative binomial's home_active recall difference is −0.055 [−0.087, −0.024] with current windows, favouring the reference, and +0.029 [−0.004, +0.063] in the recursion, uncertain; it was not adopted.
The held-out record: on 43 held-out CASAS homes, K1's home_active recall difference is −0.000 [−0.003, +0.002], negligible.

The ContextAct transfer record: for one independent resident, the time prior's gain held, K1 +0.049 [+0.013, +0.087], a success; with the prior, the CASAS-fitted hurdle channels lost 0.149 [0.076, 0.221] of balanced accuracy to the declared channels, with better log loss, K3 inconclusive.
No sub-state model had been fitted to, or run on, any CASAS household before this protocol was frozen; the code was exercised on simulated homes only.

mechanism.cells: the cells whose quiet-run statistic the predictive checks judged against the population hurdle
mechanism.conclusion: falls when it falls in every mechanism state; falls in part when it falls in some; does not fall when it is unchanged or rises in every one; inconclusive otherwise
mechanism.described: each split state's remaining log ratio under the model and the reference, signed and read the same way, is described beside it
mechanism.household_value: for each mechanism state, the mean over a household's cells of the absolute value of the reference's log ratio minus that of the model's; positive means the model's prediction is nearer the observed long quiet runs, whichever side of them it lies
mechanism.model: the fold's sub-state model: each replicate draws the sub-state path of every stretch from the entry distribution and the chain, then each window's silence from its sub-state
mechanism.question: whether the excess of long quiet runs falls
mechanism.reading: the predictive checks' household reading, with the minimal ratio 1.25: positive is falls, negative rises, negligible unchanged
mechanism.reference: the fold's population hurdle, drawn exactly as the predictive checks drew it, with their seeds
mechanism.states: the states whose quiet runs the predictive checks found positive against the population hurdle: home_active and home_inactive
mechanism.statistic: the predictive checks' quiet_runs: windows in runs of at least 12 silent windows within stretches, observed over the mean of 200 replicates of the cell's windows

filter_periodic_hurdle.channels: fitted hurdle, one per channel and state
filter_periodic_hurdle.transition: the time prior's at each window's hour

filter_periodic_substates.channels: fitted hurdle, one per channel and joint state: two sub-states in each split state, one in every other
filter_periodic_substates.transition: the time prior's between behavioural states; within a split state, its sub-state chain; a state is entered in its fitted entry distribution

name: phase3-activity-substates

one_run.amendments: a change to a pinned source after the freeze, a fix or a change merged on develop, is declared in artifacts/phase3/substates_amendments.json before the run, with its reason and the digest of every source it changes; the run accepts a changed source only at the digest an amendment gives, and the record lists the amendments as an input
one_run.branch: the run writes run-artifacts/phase3-activity-substates, and the workflow refuses to run when that branch exists
one_run.crash: a run that stops before writing its record reports nothing; it is fixed without looking at any outcome, the fix is declared as an amendment, and it is run again
one_run.runs: one scoring run, dispatched on develop
one_run.sources: the freeze records the digest of every file of the sensor_modeling package and of pyproject.toml, scripts/freeze_phase3_substates.py, scripts/run_phase3_substates.py, .github/workflows/run-phase3-substates.yml, and the versions of numpy, scipy, pandas; the run refuses when a source differs

per_state_recall.verdict: the same verdicts with the recall minimal difference; insufficient with fewer than 5 households in which the state is labelled

predictive_protocol.used: its cells, stretches, quiet-run statistic, replicates, seeds, sufficiency rule, minimal ratio and household reading

question: whether two activity sub-states in the common states, entering the filter's recursion with the time prior, recover home_active recall without costing balanced accuracy, log loss or calibration

recursion.joint_states: 11: two for each of the four split states and one for each of the three others
recursion.regime: online: no estimate reads a window after its own
recursion.scored: the belief in each behavioural state, the sum over its sub-states, scored by its most probable state
recursion.start: one step before the first window, the prior's distribution at that window's hour, each split state in its entry distribution
recursion.transition: into each window, the time prior's at the local hour at the window's end, the population prior for every held-out household, expanded to the joint states: within a split state, the prior's probability of staying times the sub-state chain; into another state, the prior's probability times that state's entry distribution
recursion.windows: every window of the recording at the base step of 300 seconds; both models receive the same windows, and only labelled windows are scored

runtime: measured on simulated homes before the freeze: EM costs about 1.4 microseconds per training window and iteration, under 20 seconds per fold for the roughly 110,000 training windows a fold has in the split states; the recursion over 11 joint states costs about 14 microseconds per window
status: pre-specified, on the development panel, which earlier work has inspected; not a held-out claim

the_check.otherwise: nothing is reported, not even per household
what: every fold's fitted channels and time prior equal the fitted-rates record's, parameter by parameter
every household's scores of filter_periodic_hurdle in the recursion equal the combined-prior record's
every cell's quiet-run statistic against the population hurdle equals the predictive-check record's

tuning: none: every setting is the base protocols' or declared here
what_this_cannot_show: A held-out claim: the 20 homes have been inspected in earlier work, and the 43 held-out CASAS homes are used up for confirmation. A success here needs an independent dataset not yet scored with this family to be confirmed.
Which within-state dependence the data have: a success shows that two shared sub-states help, not that the dependence is shared by the channels or has two levels.
Uncertainty in the fits: each fold's ten training homes share one fit, and the household bootstrap resamples the scored homes only, so the intervals leave out how the fits would vary.
Selection: the family, the split states and the mechanism states were chosen from the predictive checks on these same 20 homes, so M1 is not an independent test of the mechanism.
Transfer: the sub-states add parameters to channels that did not transfer to the one independent resident of ContextAct, so a gain here may not survive a change of homes, sensors or annotation.
Dependence between channels: given the joint state, the channels are still independent.
Anything about TIHM or the online pipeline, whose defaults this does not change.
